title.zh: Hyperliquid获首笔1458万美元USDC储备收入，按当前规模年化约1.93亿美元
title.en: Hyperliquid获首笔1458万美元USDC储备收入，按当前规模年化约1.93亿美元

current_state.zh: Hyperliquid's AQAv2 treasury mechanism completed its first $14.58M USDC payment on Oct 3 — funds directed to the assistance fund for HYPE buybacks — establishing a reserve-yield revenue stream estimated at roughly $193M annualized at current scale.
